items.html: The Guf of Adam was of the last six of the past Yetzira, because the Guf means the Ot Vav, and Yetzira is also Ot Vav. Thus, Yetzira controls Eretz Israel and you find that the Guf of Adam was from Eretz Israel which is from Yetzira, which is between two Olamot Beria and Assiya. Also, the Guf of Adam is the middle of the whole of Adam.
